ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Scheme: Uncovering the Network
ideas.description: Investigate the individuals and organizations involved in the $3.5 million Medicaid fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover the network of individuals and entities involved.
questions: What was the extent of the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger issue with healthcare fraud in Minnesota and potentially lead to further investigations.

ideas.title: FBI Warrant Controversy: Examining Oversight
ideas.description: Examine the use of debunked claims in the FBI's warrant for Fulton County vote records.
ideas.angle: Investigate the implications of using debunked claims for an FBI warrant.
questions: What were the debunked claims used?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight issues with FBI oversight and the potential for abuse of power.
